mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_jobs, COUNT(DISTINCT company) AS total_companies, COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS total_cities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill) AS total_skills, SUM( CASE WHEN salary_min IS NOT NULL AND salary_max IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS salary_known_jobs, SUM( CASE WHEN salary_min IS NULL OR salary_max IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS salary_unknown_jobs FROM job
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM job GROUP BY city ORDER BY job_count DESC, city ASC
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM job GROUP BY category ORDER BY job_count DESC, category ASC

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS job_count, CAST(ROUND(AVG(salary_min), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_salary_min, CAST(ROUND(AVG(salary_max), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_salary_max, CAST( ROUND(AVG((salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0), 0) AS SIGNED ) AS average_salary_mid FROM job WHERE salary_min IS NOT NULL AND salary_max IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY job_count DESC, category ASC
